subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers refresh/adopt one of the conflicting fork PRs, or sponsor a fresh same-repository Feishu URL-boundary fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug is valid and narrow, but the current open closing PRs are external fork PRs with conflicts and the issue is already marked no-new-fix-pr, so automation should not create another duplicate branch without maintainer direction.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
options.body: Queue one narrow Feishu plugin fix with focused tests and live Feishu proof, using the closed and fork PRs as source context only.

options.title: Refresh a fork candidate
options.body: Pick one fork PR, resolve conflicts, and require regression coverage plus real Feishu behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor follow-up
options.body: Keep this issue open until a contributor updates a candidate branch with mergeable code and proof.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
recommendation.body: Queue one narrow Feishu plugin fix with focused tests and live Feishu proof, using the closed and fork PRs as source context only.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu send-path maintenance makes this the strongest available owner signal for choosing the repair path.
